Positions Available: Waiter
Location: Darwin, Northern Territory
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $67,510–$75,000

ABOUT US
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

ABOUT THE EMPLOYER
We are supporting a hospitality group (SXW Pty Ltd) based in Darwin that operates across several popular venues, specialising in Aussie-Italian and Aussie-Filipino fusion cuisine. The business is known for it's commitment to handcrafted meals, warm service, and consistent customer satisfaction. They are currently hiring for the following role: Waiter/Waitress. These roles offer a great opportunity to join a dynamic team and grow within a stable, fast-paced hospitality environment.

WAITER / WAITRESS
Job Overview:
The Waiter will provide courteous and attentive table service, contributing to a smooth and enjoyable dining experience for all guests.

Key Responsibilities
Greet customers, take orders, and serve food and drinks.
Maintain cleanliness of tables and dining areas.
Ensure a high standard of customer satisfaction.
Assist in preparing FOH areas before and after service.

Requirements:
Previous experience in table service preferred.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work under pressure in a team environment.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS
Competitive salary starting at $67,510 (with scope to increase based on experience)
Opportunities for internal advancement and skills training
Positive, inclusive work environment

HOW TO APPLY
We are looking for professionals who are passionate about hospitality and can demonstrate their experience clearly and confidently.

To apply, submit the following:
Resume outlining your work experience and references.
A short cover letter (max. 300 words) explaining:
Why you are applying for this position; and
An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork (use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result).
A Written Response (max. 600 words) describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the role you are applying for. Please structure your example(s) using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a vibrant team and contributing to a high-quality hospitality experience, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Walk-in applications will not be accepted.

On behalf of our client – a community-focused organization dedicated to empowering individuals with disabilities and mental health challenges – we are seeking a compassionate Youth Worker. Strategic & Operational Management

Program & Resource Coordination

Administrative & Financial Control

Representation & Advocacy

Staff Leadership

Requirements

• Minimum 1 to 2 years of full-time relevant experience

About the Client
Our client is seeking a compassionate Community Worker to deliver holistic support that empowers clients to achieve independence and wellbeing. You will work within a collaborative team, assessing needs, coordinating services, and advocating for vulnerable individuals across the community.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
• Conduct comprehensive client assessments to identify physical, emotional, social, and financial needs; then develop, implement, and review individualized support and education plans.
• Interview clients and their families to understand the nature and extent of difficulties, ensuring culturally sensitive and client-led approaches.
• Monitor and document client progress, adjusting interventions as required, and report outcomes to relevant stakeholders.
• Refer clients to appropriate agencies for additional help – including housing, healthcare, employment, and disability services – and follow up to ensure continuity of care.
• Assess community needs and resource gaps in health, welfare, housing, and training, and liaise with community groups, government bodies, and private businesses to promote awareness of available services.
• Provide direct support, education, and advocacy for families, children, and disabled persons in home, group housing, or community settings.
• Assist young people with social, emotional, and financial challenges through counselling, life skills training, and referrals.
• Prepare funding submissions, grant applications, and detailed reports for government bodies and other agencies.

Requirements
• Diploma or higher in community services, social work, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
• Minimum one-year relevant experience in community services, social work, or disability support.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build trust with diverse clients and stakeholders.
• Knowledge of the NDIS, aged care, and mental health sectors is highly regarded.
• Current driver’s license and valid working with children check.

Store/Retail Manager

Coober Pedy Cellar Pty Ltd is seeking an experienced and reliable Retail Manager to oversee the day-to-day management of its liquor retail operations.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing store operations, improving customer service standards, supporting sales growth, overseeing stock selection, and ensuring the business operates efficiently and in accordance with applicable liquor licensing requirements.

Location: Coober Pedy, South Australia
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent and Ongoing
Annual Remuneration: $80,000 to $86,000 p.a. plus super.


Key responsibilities

As the Retail Manager, you will be responsible for:

•	Managing the day-to-day store operations. 
•	Developing retail objectives and preparing and implementing operating plans, marketing strategies, advertising initiatives, and store improvement plans
•	Determining the products and brands to be stocked by reviewing product trends, sales trends, and customer preferences
•	Setting prices for merchandise to achieve required profit margins while ensuring compliance with liquor restrictions
•	Achieve financial targets and develop budgets.
•	Selecting suppliers and vendors and placing stock orders within budget
•	Overseeing promotional activities and ensuring effective presentation of products
•	Setting customer service objectives and ensuring high service standards are maintained
•	Managing team.
•	Ensuring the store operates safely, efficiently, and in compliance with relevant laws, policies, and procedures


To be considered for this role, applicants should have:

•	At least 3 years of full time or part time equivalent experience in retail management, preferably within liquor retail or a similar customer-facing retail environment
•	A relevant diploma or higher qualification or at least 3 years of relevant experience in lieu of a qualification
•	Strong knowledge of retail operations, stock control, pricing, sales, and customer service
•	Ability to analyse sales trends and customer preferences
•	Strong communication, leadership, and organisational skills
•	Ability to manage suppliers, budgets, promotions, and day-to-day store operations
•	Understanding of liquor retail compliance requirements
•	Appropriate rights to work in Australia

This is a suitable opportunity for a motivated Retail Manager who can take responsibility for store performance, staff coordination, customer service, and operational standards.
Applications from suitably qualified candidates are encouraged.


How to apply:

Applications open on 24 July 2026 and close on 23 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

 About the Partnership 
 Randstad is excited to be supporting our valued business partner, a global market leader in sustainable building solutions and infrastructure materials, to source an enthusiastic  Customer Service Officer  for their high-performing Brisbane team. 
 About the Company & Culture 
 This is an outstanding opportunity to align your career with a global organisation highly recognised for its commitment to sustainability, green tech innovation, and workplace excellence. Certified as a  Top Employer 2026 , this business thrives on a genuinely supportive, family-focused culture that prioritises its people. 
 Operating from a modern office in Milton, you will enjoy premium amenities including close proximity to public transport, local dining venues, and a full kitchen and diner overlooking the river. The company strongly believes in celebrating effort and achievement - offering regular team lunches, marking personal milestones like birthdays, and driving recognition awards for team members who go above and beyond. You will report to an open, approachable, and actively engaged management team that genuinely welcomes new perspectives and fresh ideas. 
 The Opportunity 
 Working within a fun, dynamic, and well-established team environment, you will provide critical B2B customer service support to a diverse supply chain network and client base ranging from site personnel to project managers. This fast-paced role perfectly combines handling inbound enquiries with managing outbound order confirmations. 
 This is a permanent, full-time position. The Customer Service Centre operates between 5:00am and 4:30pm, Monday to Friday, and you will need flexibility to work rotating shifts starting between 5:00am and 8:30am. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 
 
  Customer Support:  Handle B2B customer enquiries promptly and courteously, keeping clients updated on schedules or delays. 
 
 
  Order Processing:  Process incoming customer orders accurately and efficiently within internal systems. 
 
 
  Internal Liaison:  Maintain regular communication with sales, production, operations, and scheduling teams to ensure customer requirements are met. 
 
 
  Issue Resolution:  Escalate complex customer issues to appropriate managers while utilising problem-solving skills to manage conflict. 
 
 
  Logistics Collaboration:  Liaise with dispatchers as necessary to support cost-reduction initiatives while maintaining optimum service levels. 
 
 
  Continuous Improvement:  Maintain compliance with standard operational procedures and actively contribute to process improvements. 
 
 
 About You 
 To be successful in this role, you will be a motivated professional looking to leverage or grow your experience within the broader supply chain sector. 
  Requirements include:  
 
 
 Proven previous experience in a dedicated customer service, supply chain support, or operational support role. 
 
 
 Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment: managing a high volume of phone interactions, problem solving, liaising with other departments - sometimes simultaneously.  
 
 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage openly with stakeholders and supply chain partners at all levels. 
 
 
 Excellent attention to detail and high proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google suites. 
 
 
 Prior experience in industrial supply chain, logistics, or construction materials is advantageous, but absolutely not essential as full training is provided. 
 
 
  What's on Offer 
 
 
  Enterprise Stability:  Secure a permanent career blueprint with a stable national industry leader. 
 
 
  True Reward & Recognition:  Access to structured recognition awards for going over and above, alongside regular celebratory lunches and milestone events. 
 
 
  Engaged Leadership:  Work with an approachable, supportive management team that values your voice.

  Comprehensive Benefits:  Access to a range of corporate employee discounts, learning and development pathways, and mental and physical well-being initiatives. 
 
 
  Inclusive Environment:  A safe, diverse, and high-performance workplace that empowers creative thinkers.
